headline: Virginia directs statewide preparedness planning for AI-related cyber threats
summary: Virginia Executive Directive 6 (2026), signed 23 October, extends the AI cyber-risk remit of the state task force created by Executive Order 22 in September. It establishes a Cyber Consortium inside the Unified Readiness Framework and orders statewide cyber-response and infrastructure-hardening plans, quarterly briefings, an annual tabletop exercise and an independent privacy and security review of interoperable state data systems.
